title: About
description: The /about route: the company-narrative shape with a team roster and the investor wall.

content.heading: We make money movement feel effortless

photo.alt: A desk overlooking the California coast

paragraphs: The company was incorporated on August 12th, 2025, inspired by a 15-page memo Kahlil wrote that summer. It was a bold vision for what the world would become.
Within 72 hours of sharing the memo, Natural raised a $10M seed round from the best investors in technology and financial services.
At the time, Natural was simply words on paper. We had conviction that the shift ahead was inevitable, and were committed to building the company that would shape it.

content.heading: The largest market payments has ever seen

items.headline: This is a fundamental platform shift
items.description: Over the next decade, agents will execute a majority of global payment volume. We're building the rails to support it.

items.headline: We're early and there's no winner yet
items.description: The category is new enough that the defining company has not been decided. We intend to be it.

items.headline: Payments infrastructure compounds
items.description: Every wallet, transfer and dispute we handle makes the network more useful to the next agent that joins it.

content.heading: Today, the team is 20 people. All based in San Francisco
Backed by the best investors and operators in fintech
